title: Zesty Yeasty Malaysian Renkon Lotus Root Satay
description: A romantic Malaysian dish featuring renkon lotus root, flambe, and a yeasty twist, perfect for a Whole30-friendly dinner

ingredients.name: Renkon lotus root
ingredients.notes: peeled and sliced into 1-inch thick rounds

instructions: In a large bowl, combine coconut milk, fish sauce, lime juice, and yeast, and stir to dissolve the yeast
Add the sliced renkon lotus root to the bowl and marinate for at least 30 minutes
Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat
Remove the lotus root from the marinade and cook for 3-4 minutes per side, or until slightly charred
In a small saucepan, heat the ghee over medium heat
Add the salt and black pepper to the ghee and stir to combine
Flambe the ghee mixture by igniting it with a match or lighter
Serve the grilled lotus root with the flambe ghee sauce spooned over the top
